title_as_printed: Experimental Apparent Molar Volumes and Compressibilities for NaCl-CaCl2 Mixtures at 25 C
property_description: density of the solution minus density of pure water at 25 C (measured, vibrating-tube densimeter); value = printed 10^3 (d - d0) times 0.001 in g/cm3; d0 not tabulated, the builder uses IAPWS-95 water density

value.what: measured density difference d - d0 (printed as 10^3 (d - d0), g-cm^-3)

y_CaCl2.note: y_B = 3 m_B/(m_A + 3 m_B) with B = CaCl2 and A = NaCl (y=1 reproduces the pure CaCl2 values of Table I at the same ionic strength)

composition.other_species: NaCl + CaCl2 at constant ionic strength I = m_A + 3 m_B, I printed in the block label rows (units mol/kg, molal basis implied by Eq. 1 and I = m_A + 3 m_B, not spelled out)

skip_rows.reason: printed summary rows: standard deviation sigma of fitted vs measured (d-d0) and (u-u0)

extra_unmapped: -10^4 K_phi* (apparent molar adiabatic compressibility, calculated by authors)
V_phi* cm^3-mol^-1 [b] (V_phi, apparent molar volume, derived by the authors from d via Eq. 3)
(u - u0) cm-sec^-1 [c] (sound-velocity difference, not a density)
conversion_needs: molalities: m_NaCl = I (1 - y), m_CaCl2 = I y / 3 (from y_B = 3 m_B/(m_A+3 m_B) and I = m_A + 3 m_B)
value2 = d - d0 scale 1e-3; absolute density needs pure-water density at 25 C (not tabulated)
notes: Block 'Ionic Strength = 1' is split over two printed pages (labels 'Ionic Strength = 1.0' and 'Ionic Strength = 1 (cont)'; both set I = 1.0). Blocks at I = 10, 15, 20 contain only the high-y rows because pure NaCl solutions do not exist at those concentrations (author's text). Sigma values for I = 10, 15, 20 are flagged by the authors as not to be taken seriously. Printed values at I=0.5, y=0.8504 (u-u0 = 1926) and I=1, y=0.9510 (u-u0 = 3526) look out of sequence in the sound-velocity column; kept as printed (not density columns).
pressure_note: not stated (no pressure given for the vibrating-tube densimeter or sound-velocity measurements)
volume_basis_evidence: apparent molar volume Vphi = V - n1 V1(0) with n1 = moles of H2O per kg of H2O (Eq. 2); density is reported as the difference d - d0 in g cm^-3, no per-volume concentration is tabulated
quality_remarks: audit 2026-10-02: Primary measured quantity is the density difference (d - d0), p.862 'primary experimental property (d - do)'; V_phi is derived by the authors. The paper states no pressure, so the rows stay held on 'pressure missing'.
